title: The Origin and the Rule
teaches: Definition of an orbit word starting with X and the simultaneous rewriting rules.
visual: A large, bold 'X' appears in the center. Two arrows point from it: one labeled 'X → XYY' (blue) and another 'Y → YX' (green). The words 'Simultaneous Rewrite' pulse briefly above.
narration: An orbit word begins with a single letter, X. To grow, we rewrite every letter at the same time: replace each X with XYY, and each Y with YX.

title: Step 1: From X to XYY
teaches: Applying the rule to the starting word for the first iteration.
visual: The 'X' from the previous scene splits into three letters: 'X', 'Y', 'Y'. They align horizontally as 'XYY'. A bracket highlights that the original X became XYY, while no Ys existed yet.
narration: Starting with X, we apply the rule. Since there is only one X, it becomes XYY. The word grows from length 1 to length 3.

title: Step 2: From XYY to XYYYXYX
teaches: Applying the rule simultaneously to all letters in the second iteration.
visual: The word 'XYY' is shown. Below it, each letter transforms simultaneously: The 'X' becomes 'XYY', the first 'Y' becomes 'YX', and the second 'Y' becomes 'YX'. These chunks merge into 'XYYYXYX'.
narration: Now rewrite every letter in XYY at once. The X becomes XYY, and each Y becomes YX. Concatenating these gives us the new orbit word: XYYYXYX.

title: Verification and Growth
teaches: Confirming the result and emphasizing the growth property.
visual: The final word 'XYYYXYX' is displayed prominently. A counter shows 'Length: 7'. An arrow points to the text 'Every rewrite makes the word longer', with a checkmark appearing next to it.
narration: We have successfully generated the second orbit word. Notice that every rewrite strictly increases the length, ensuring the orbit word grows indefinitely.
